note: Five stages from a fresh save to the platinum. Every step is written in our own words and cites the numbered sources in sources.json. A step counts as one claim; a claim with two or more source numbers is backed by 2+ sources.

stages.goal: Set up your save and settings so nothing in the hunt can bite you later.
stages.name: Stage 0 — Before you start

steps.text: Make a manual save at the start of every chapter; there is no mission replay and no New Game+ to fall back on.
Use all 15 manual save slots plus the autosave; keep one save from before the final mission untouched.
Turn off cheats entirely — they unlock only after the story, each behind its own challenge, and using one switches trophies and saving off for the session.
There are 61 cheats in total; the $250,000 money cheat is the only cash cheat, and the cash doesn't stick because saving stops.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so Actions Speak Louder is visible as it grows.
There are no difficulty settings, so there is no difficulty to choose or change.
Play on one profile and one save for the whole hunt; progress is tied to that save.

stages.goal: Play the story and pick up the one thing that might be missable.
stages.name: Stage 1 — Chapters 1–2

steps.text: Play the story and let the chapter and mission trophies pop as they come: Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost, T**s Ass Drug Money, Trust.
Story missions need no gold medals — just finish them.
In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in the morning — it is the only possibly missable trophy in the list.
Scan vehicles and WAiNK spots as you travel; both counts feed trophies and the 100% checklist later.
Meet Cal in Chapter 1 (Feng Shui) and follow his fishing line toward Baited My Tackle.
Meet Kenton after Island Dreams and start his seven shipwrecks; he goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later.
Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break to unlock free roaming with both characters and the partner trophies.
After Coffee Break, try Hot Together and Retail Therapy with your partner, and start Billy's line at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Play a full video game at home for Stick Fiddler whenever the TV is available.
Keep a manual save at the end of each chapter.

stages.goal: Finish the story and open every robbery tool and questline.
stages.name: Stage 2 — Chapters 3–5

steps.text: Play the story through Chapters 3–5; the remaining story trophies pop with the campaign.
In Chapter 3, finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun, Credit Check for the Dye Pack Jammer, and Clonin' Keys for the Key Cloner.
Start Andy's five quests (Lucia-only), Tyrone's labs (Jason-only) and Randy's 16-car wish list as they open in Chapter 3.
Start Bret's hunting line (Jason-only) after Coffee Break and work through his 15 Target Decks.
In Chapter 4, do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock the large bank vaults.
Rob jewelry stores, gang operations and payday loans as they appear — they feed several trophies and the checklist at once.
Save before the final mission; after the credits, free roam continues and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats.
The story takes about 60–80 hours of the roughly 200-hour platinum, so don't rush the side content yet.

stages.goal: Clear the checklist for A Long Road, the hardest trophy in the list.
stages.name: Stage 3 — 100% Completion

steps.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list in any order; nothing on it is missable.
The in-game weights are story 50%, tasks 27%, exploration 20% and discovery 3% — they don't change what to do, so work in any order.
Scan vehicles and study animals from the start; both finish naturally by the end if you keep at them.
Clear the full-count robbery lines first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans and 8 vaults.
Finish the full-clear lines: 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 15 Bret decks, 2 playlists and 4 video games.
Hit the partial targets: 100 optional tasks, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK, 30 of 34 magazines and 15 of 18 meditations.
Fence $100,000 of narcotics, $100,000 of jewelry, $250,000 of Marked Bills and $200,000 of vehicles through your contacts.
Reach 300 of 397 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges last — you can skip the ten hardest challenges.
The checklist only covers about 60% of the game's true content, so the targets are forgiving.
When the checklist reads 100%, A Long Road pops and only cleanup is left.

stages.goal: Finish the stranger strands, the unsolved trophies and anything still outstanding.
stages.name: Stage 4 — Strangers & cleanup

steps.text: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks; check the trophy counter after each one, since only some lines count.
Do Yago's timed race the moment it appears; it carries an hourglass icon.
Sweep the tracker for anything un-earned: count trophies, the five unconfirmed trophies and the partner trophies if they haven't popped.
Re-check the five unsolved trophies (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — the community may have cracked them since this guide was written.
When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! — the platinum — unlocks automatically.
